Source   Edit  

MdFileAdapter — MemoryPort backed by Markdown files in a paddock directory.

Paddock root: {paddocksDir}/{userId}/ Files managed: USER.md, MEMORY.md, PREFERENCES.md

All I/O is synchronous (proc). The domain layer (func) uses the pure UserContext value; this adapter is the side-effectful shell.

../../core/types, ../../ports/memory, ../../domain/message, ../../domain/personality, ../../ports/embedding, ../embedding/openrouter_embed, magma_memory_adapter

MdFileAdapter = object
  paddocksDir*: string       ## base directory, e.g. ~/.donkey/paddocks
  magmaDsn*: string          ## optional MAGMA shadow backend DSN
